description: v2.2 empirical 115-point calibration strictly from training seeds .01-.05 (575 nanoBragg2 1AHO datasets; seeds .06-.10 held out for validation), with 18-knot XDS transfer T_xds(u), high-u within-shell profile/summation non-linearity delta_nl_u1, 3-knot (u, I/I_Wilson) random scatter + low-u shell bleed floor c_wbg, 16-knot outer-corner beta_bg(u) + per-seed radial-ring background fluctuation sigma_bg_cor, and XDSCONV sliding-window truncation.
